name: Hired Gun 3 - Reunion
source:
Victor is sent on a mission to France to kill an arms dealer. But, it looks like his target is aware of that. So, there may be many obstacles in his path. When he gets the information that Robinette is still alive, he vows to himself that he will save her no matter what. Will he be able to? Visit five different countries- France, Japan, Scotland, Egypt and North Korea. This game also includes a mini-game and five event CGIs.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210100908/http://renai.us/game/Hired_gun-reunion.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
维克托奉命前往法国，刺杀一位军火商。然而，目标似乎已经察觉了他的计划，因此，他的行动可能会遭遇重重阻碍。当得知罗比内特仍然活着时，他向自己发誓，无论如何都要救出她。他能做到吗？你将前往五个不同的国家和地区：法国、日本、苏格兰、埃及与朝鲜。本作还包含一个小游戏和五张事件CG。

（摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210100908/http://renai.us/game/Hired_gun-reunion.shtml]Ren’Ai档案库[/url]）
